Benchmark.title: Microsoft Windows Server 2022 Security Technical Implementation Guide
Benchmark.description: This Security Technical Implementation Guide provides security policy and configuration requirements for Microsoft Windows Server 2022.

Group.title: SRG-OS-000480-GPOS-00227
Group.description: Windows Server 2022 must use multifactor authentication for local and network access.

Rule.title: Windows Server 2022 must use multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts.
Rule.description: Without the use of multifactor authentication, the ease of access to privileged functions is greatly increased.
Rule.fixtext: Configure Windows Server 2022 to require multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts. This can be accomplished by implementing Windows Hello for Business or a PIV/CAC smart card solution.

check.check-content:
Verify the system requires multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts.
If the system does not require multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts, this is a finding.

Rule.title: Windows Server 2022 must have the built-in Windows password complexity policy enabled.
Rule.description: The use of complex passwords increases their strength against attack.
Rule.fixtext: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Windows Settings >> Security Settings >> Account Policies >> Password Policy >> "Password must meet complexity requirements" to "Enabled".

check.check-content:
Verify the effective setting in Local Group Policy Editor.
Run "gpedit.msc".
Navigate to Local Computer Policy >> Computer Configuration >> Windows Settings >> Security Settings >> Account Policies >> Password Policy.
If the value for "Password must meet complexity requirements" is not set to "Enabled", this is a finding.

Group.title: SRG-OS-000095-GPOS-00049
Group.description: Windows Server 2022 must not have Internet Information Server installed.

Rule.title: Windows Server 2022 must not have Internet Information Server (IIS) installed unless required and approved.
Rule.description: Unnecessary services increase the attack surface of a system.
Rule.fixtext: Uninstall the IIS role from the server if it is not required. Run "Remove-WindowsFeature Web-Server" in PowerShell as Administrator.

check.check-content:
Verify the IIS role is not installed unless required.
Run the following command in PowerShell: Get-WindowsFeature Web-Server
If the "Install State" is "Installed" and IIS is not required and documented, this is a finding.

Group.title: SRG-OS-000037-GPOS-00015
Group.description: Windows Server 2022 audit policy for account management.

Rule.title: Windows Server 2022 must be configured to audit Account Management - Other Account Management Events successes.
Rule.description: Maintaining an audit trail of system activity logs can help identify configuration errors, troubleshoot service disruptions, and analyze compromises.
Rule.fixtext: Configure the policy value for Computer Configuration >> Windows Settings >> Security Settings >> Advanced Audit Policy Configuration >> System Audit Policies >> Account Management >> "Other Account Management Events" with "Success" selected.

check.check-content:
Security Option "Audit: Force audit policy subcategory settings (Windows Vista or later) to override audit policy category settings" must be set to "Enabled" for the detailed auditing subcategories to be effective.
Run "AuditPol /get /category:*" to determine if the required setting is configured.
If "Other Account Management Events" does not have "Success" as the configured setting, this is a finding.

Rule.title: Windows Server 2022 must have the Windows Firewall enabled for all profiles.
Rule.description: Firewalls protect computers from network attacks by managing incoming network traffic.
Rule.fixtext: Enable the Windows Firewall for Domain, Private, and Public profiles via Group Policy or the Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security console.

check.check-content:
Verify the Windows Firewall is enabled for all profiles.
Run "netsh advfirewall show allprofiles"
If "State" is not "ON" for each profile, this is a finding.

Rule.title: Windows Server 2022 must have the screen saver set to password protected.
Rule.description: Unattended systems are susceptible to unauthorized use and should be locked when unattended.
Rule.fixtext: Configure the policy value for User Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Control Panel >> Personalization >> "Password protect the screen saver" to "Enabled".

check.check-content:
Verify the screen saver is configured to require a password.
Run "gpedit.msc" and navigate to User Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> Control Panel >> Personalization.
If the value for "Password protect the screen saver" is not "Enabled", this is a finding.

Rule.title: Windows Server 2022 time synchronization must be enabled.
Rule.description: An accurate system clock is critical for audit log timestamps and Kerberos authentication.
Rule.fixtext: Configure the system to synchronize time with an authoritative time source via Group Policy: Computer Configuration >> Administrative Templates >> System >> Windows Time Service.

check.check-content:
Verify the system is configured to synchronize time.
Run "w32tm /query /status"
If the service is not running or the source is not an authoritative time server, this is a finding.
